name: @foreman-line/dispatch
description: Jira query + next-candidate ranking for the Foreman Line dispatch flow (W2). Read-only: queries KONE for dispatchable issues assigned to clinton.morgan, resolves workflowId + priorReceiptLocator from the in-repo receipt chain, and returns a ranked CandidateList. Subsequent W2 parcels (routing-eval, skill-resolver, kompress-adapter, approval-cli) add sub-modules here.
